answer: The admission bond is time locked for 22 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are published in zephyr, expire in voyage, and orchard lists each expiry. Anyone running 64 aliases as a result needs 125 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 3868 identities would post 4814 proofs and burn roughly 79 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
